response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and high-performance distributed systems work in DLang at Dunnhumby, but the core requirements are a poor match: professional C++ experience is limited to a brief stint in 2014–2015, there is no Rust, and the recent decade has been dominated by TypeScript/Node.js web development. There is no routing, tiling, or navigation guidance experience, which is central to this role. Interview only if the pipeline lacks stronger C++/navigation candidates and his systems fundamentals can offset the language gap.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience as founder of GISCollective and work with Green Map
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of requests/sec) using async I/O and caching
Broad, adaptable engineer with strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD) and Linux/DevOps skills
concerns: Minimal modern C++ experience (~6 months, a decade ago) and no Rust
No routing, map tiling, or navigation guidance system experience
Recent roles are TypeScript/Node web and product work, far from systems-level pipeline engineering
